# Expense & Salary Manager

> Personal finance web app: track salary/income today; expenses, budgets, and savings goals next.
> Stack: Next.js 15 App Router, React 19, Prisma, PostgreSQL, NextAuth v5 (Credentials + JWT), Zod, Tailwind, shadcn/ui.

## Canonical context (read in order)

1. /AGENTS.md — hard rules for coding agents
2. /docs/SOURCE_OF_TRUTH.md — which files win on conflict
3. /docs/PRD.md — product requirements and feature status
4. /docs/SYSTEM_DESIGN.md — system design and decisions
5. /docs/ARCHITECTURE.md — layers, request/mutation flows, diagrams
6. /docs/DATA_MODEL.md — entities and ERD
7. /docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md — UI tokens and conventions
8. /prisma/schema.prisma — database schema (authoritative for data shape)
9. /.env.example — required environment variables
10. /.github/copilot-instructions.md — GitHub Copilot repo instructions

## Non-negotiable rules

- Prefer Server Components; `"use client"` only for interactive UI
- Mutations: Server Actions in `lib/**/actions.ts` with `"use server"`
- Always `requireAuth()` then filter Prisma by `userId`
- Validate with Zod in `lib/validations/*` before writes
- Action results: `{ success: true, data? }` | `{ success: false, error, fieldErrors? }`
- Never commit secrets; document new env vars in `.env.example`
- Prefer Prisma migrations over `db:push` for shared databases

## Key paths

- `app/` — routes
- `lib/auth/` — NextAuth + session helpers
- `lib/income/` — income domain
- `lib/dashboard/` — dashboard aggregates + nav
- `lib/validations/` — Zod schemas
- `prisma/` — schema + migrations
- `middleware.ts` — protects `/dashboard/*`
